title: Ukrainian Fried Pilaf with Vegetables
description: A hearty, flavorful pilaf dish from Ukraine, made with crispy fried onions and a variety of colorful vegetables.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the kicked onions and cook until they start to brown, about 3 minutes.
Add the peas to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the peas and onions.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pilaf mixture to a serving dish and top with fried onions.
